name: 收益还原法（资本化率）评估

map.收益还原法评估工具，基于V=NOI/r公式计算房产价值，输入年租金、空置率、运营: An income capitalization tool built on V = NOI/r: enter annual rent, vacancy rate, operating expense ratio and cap rate to get net operating income (NOI) and appraised value.
map.📖 查看「收益还原法（资本化率）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Income Capitalization Valuation (Cap Rate) User Guide"
map.土地价值(万元)-剩余法用: Land value (¥10,000) - for the residual method
map.收益还原法核心公式：V=NOI/r（价值=净收益/资本化率）: Core formula: V = NOI/r (value = net operating income / cap rate)
map.资本化率是收益法的核心参数，取值4%-8%不等: The cap rate is the key income-approach parameter and ranges from 4% to 8%
map.一线城市优质资产资本化率较低(4%-5%)，二三线较高(6%-8%): Prime tier-1 city assets run lower cap rates (4%-5%) and tier-2 and tier-3 cities higher (6%-8%)
map.毛租金倍数(GRM)在15-25倍之间为正常投资区间: A gross rent multiple (GRM) of 15-25 times is the normal investment range
map.稳定收租型物业按 NOI÷资本化率直接估值。: Value stable income-producing property directly as NOI ÷ cap rate.
map.开发项目用剩余法扣减土地价值求建筑物价值。: For development projects, deduct land value by the residual method to derive building value.
map.用 GRM、租售比判断: Use GRM and the rent-to-price ratio to judge whether returns are
map.年租金 120 万、空置 5% → 有效租金 114 万；运营费 25% → N: Annual rent of 1.2 million yuan with 5% vacancy gives effective rent of 1.14 million; operating expenses at 25% give NOI = 114 × 75% = 855,000; at a 5% cap rate, value V = 85.5/0.05 = 17.1 million yuan, with a rent-to-price ratio of 120/1710 ≈ 7.0%.
map.总开发价值按 NOI/资本化率得 1710 万，扣土地价值 600 万 → 建筑: Total development value from NOI/cap rate is 17.1 million yuan; deducting land value of 6 million gives a building value of 11.1 million yuan; it suits properties under construction or awaiting development.
map.资本化率怎么选？: How is the cap rate chosen?
map.可取市场可比交易的 NOI/售价，或风险溢价法（无风险利率+房产风险溢价），住宅: Take NOI/price from comparable market deals, or a risk-premium build (risk-free rate plus property risk premium); 4%-5% for residential and 5%-7% for commercial is common.
map.GRM 过高说明什么？: What does a high GRM mean?
map.毛租金倍数 GRM=售价/年租金，>25 倍通常回报偏低，<15 倍回报较高，需: GRM = price / annual rent; above 25 usually means a thin return and below 15 a rich one, though vacancy and expenses must be read alongside to see net income.
map.收益还原法评估工具基于V=NOI/r公式计算房产价值，输入年租金、空置率、运营费: Built on V = NOI/r, the tool takes annual rent, vacancy, operating expense ratio and cap rate to compute NOI and appraised value, supporting both direct capitalization and the residual method.
